narr: A weak cold front slowly moved across northern NY during the afternoon and evening hours of July 13th. Several rounds of tropical showers and thunderstorms traversed the area with a few storms pulsing to severe limits. In addition, localized heavy rainfall caused flash flooding in the form of a landslide.
ev: A large landslide/debris flow occurred in the Avalanche Pass/Avalanche Lake area, blocking a popular hiking trail and clogging the upper portions of Avalanche Lake with heavy debris and timber.
